meta.titulo: {marca}: your story, in a deck of cards
meta.descripcion: Upload your photos and get a card game at home where you put memories in order by date. For couples and families.

nav.prototipoDetalle: This is a prototype for the partners: payments are test payments and photos never leave your device.

errores.almacen: Your browser won’t let us save the deck (private mode?). You can carry on, but it will be lost when you close the tab.

pie.texto: {marca} is a placeholder name. Prototype for print tests.

privacidadPagina.intro: The photos in your deck are personal data and often show children. This is how we handle them:
privacidadPagina.prototipo: Photos are read and stored only in your browser (IndexedDB). They’re never uploaded to a server. The print file is also generated on your device. You can delete everything with “Start another deck”.

real.1: Photos will be stored on servers in the European Union, in private storage, and only viewable through signed links that expire within minutes.
real.2: We’ll ask for your explicit consent before uploading photos.
real.3: We’ll automatically delete original photos and print files 60 days after shipping.
real.4: We don’t run third-party analytics on your images or send them to other services.
real.5: You can ask us at any time to delete your deck and your data.

privacidadPagina.fotosTexto: The photos on the sample cards and the table in “How to play” come from {fuente}. The people in them have nothing to do with {marca}: the memories, names and dates on the cards are made up.
